title: Legal Personal Assistant
description:
Personal Assistant (Private Client)
- Location: Leatherhead
- Job Type: Full-time
- Salary: £30-£32,000

Join a leading law firm in the Southeast known for its strong history and commitment to client service. We are looking for a Personal Assistant to support our Private Client team, ensuring optimal efficiency and contributing to our tradition of excellence.

Day-to-Day of the Role:
- Provide direct support to a team of four Private Client solicitors/fee earners, alongside two other part-time secretaries.
- Prepare correspondence and documents through audio-typing and word processing.
- Manage daily filing and the maintenance of client files in accordance with office procedures.
- Prepare mail and enclosures for dispatch and handle all copying needs.
- Schedule appointments, arrange meetings, and maintain up-to-date diaries for fee earners.
- Set up and clear conference rooms for meetings and provide refreshments as needed.
- Offer support to other secretaries and provide guidance to junior and temporary secretaries.
- Engage with clients both in person and over the phone in a professional and friendly manner.
- Maintain confidentiality of all firm and client documentation and information.
- Operate the firm's case management system and undertake online form filling requirements.
- Continuously seek to improve the efficiency of the department and undertake additional duties as required.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Substantial previous legal secretarial experience, including at least 2 years in Private Client work.
- Advanced IT skills in relevant packages and fast touch typing skills.
- High levels of accuracy and professionalism in communication.
- Proactive approach to work, able to progress client matters without supervision.
- Ability to work to deadlines, cope under pressure, and effectively prioritise workloads.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, sensitive to the needs of clients during distressing times.
- Demonstrates commitment to the firm and a genuine interest in legal work.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary with annual reviews and bonus schemes.
- 5% employer pension contribution and Death in Service benefit of 4x salary.
- Private medical cover, Life Assurance, and Company sick pay.
- Cycle to Work scheme, Employee Assistance Programme, and Health and Wellbeing initiatives.
- 25 days holiday plus Bank Holidays, with enhanced maternity/paternity leave and other leave benefits.
- Flexible/hybrid working options, sabbaticals, and study leave.
- Comprehensive opportunities for personal and professional development including a Trainee Solicitor Programme and extensive CPD programme.

To apply for this Personal Assistant position, please submit your CV and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in joining to Mark Watts at Reed, your Local Legal Recruitment Manager.

title: Female Support Worker
description:
Female Support Worker - Woking

Full-time roles available - 39 hours per week

£25,845 per year pro rata

Support Worker - people-person? Love making someone's day? You already have what it takes to start a rewarding career in care - where your natural skills really make a difference.

We are looking for Support Workers to work with us in Woking. Working within a small staff team of Support Workers, you will support for 4 adults with learning disabilities, physical disabilities.

At Avenues, we believe supported people support others well. We create communities where people smile, laugh, grow, and achieve amazing things - and you could be part of that!

If you're looking for:
- More meaningful work
- Job security and flexibility
- Real career progression
- A supportive, people-first team

We've got you covered - and we'll provide all the training you need, completely free.

Your day might include:
- Helping adults with learning disabilities, autism, or physical disabilities live independently
- Supporting with everyday tasks like shopping, cooking, or household jobs.
- Encouraging social activities, community involvement, and family connections,
- Providing respectful personal care where needed,
- Making every day enjoyable - for the people we support, and for you!

Perks:
- Early Pay - access your earnings before payday
- Fully paid, enhanced DBS
- Flexible working patterns
- Paid annual leave (pro rata)
- Comprehensive training and career progression opportunities
- Contributory pension scheme with life assurance
- Discounts on shopping, holidays, and more via Blue Light Card and Benefits website

We're an inclusive employer. Under the Disability Confident Scheme, if you have a disability and meet the basic role criteria, we'll guarantee you an interview.

Ready to leave retail or hospitality behind? Apply now and start your feel-good career with Avenues!

We reserve the right to close a vacancy before the closing date in the event of an overwhelming response or a change in business priorities.

title: Support Worker
description:
Support Worker - Chertsey
£25,845 per year (pro rata) / Full time 39 hours a week

Having a full UK manual driving licence would be great for this role, as it really helps with getting out and about with the people we support

We're on the lookout for passionate and caring Support Workers with some experience to join our brilliant team at our 12-bed residential service in Chertsey. Right now, we've got 4 men and 8 women living with us, mostly needing 2 to 1 support, with some requiring 3 to 1. It's fair to say the support needs are pretty high here - there's manual handling involved, wheelchair users, and personal care support.

Person Centred Active Support is at the heart of everything we do, and we're looking for like-minded support workers to join us in supporting young adults with:
- Autism / Learning disabilities
- Physical disabilities
- Dementia
- Behaviours that challenge

No two days are the same, but you'll be:
- Supporting people to live independently and enjoy their everyday activities
- Encouraging social connections with family, friends, and the local community
- Helping out with finances, household tasks, and shopping
- Providing respectful, person-centred personal care
- Most importantly - creating those brilliant moments of joy and achievement!

At Avenues, we know that when our teams feel valued and supported, they create the best possible outcomes for the people we support. If you're looking for your next role in social care - we'd love to hear from you!

What's in it for you?
- Early Pay - get your hands on your earnings before payday
- Fully paid, enhanced DBS
- Flexible working patterns
- Paid annual leave (pro rata)
- Loads of training and opportunities to progress your career
- Contributory pension scheme with life assurance
- Discounts on shopping, holidays, and loads more via Blue Light Card and our Benefits website
- Recommend a Friend scheme - earn up to £500
- 24/7 health and wellbeing support, including confidential counselling

Join Avenues - where people smile, laugh, grow, and achieve great things together.

We celebrate diversity and welcome everyone!

As part of our commitment to the Disability Confident Scheme, candidates who declare a disability and meet the essential criteria will be guaranteed an interview.

Ready to start your feel-good career? Apply today - we can't wait to meet you!

title: Female Support Worker
description:
On the search for your next social care role, or thinking about switching things up for a career that actually feels rewarding? We'd love to chat!

New to social care? No worries at all - we'll train you up with loads of accredited and award-winning training programmes, totally free, including the Health and Social Care Diploma to give your career a proper boost.
- Female Support Worker
- Caterham.
- £25,845 per annum (pro rata)
- Full time hours available (39 hours per week)

We're looking for Female Support Workers to join us in Caterham. You'll be part of a small team of 8, supporting 5 lovely ladies with learning disabilities, epilepsy and autism. They're all mad about music and would really appreciate someone with brilliant communication skills. Plus, they're absolute fans of pamper sessions - nails, facials, you name it! It'd be ace if you've got some experience working with adults who have learning disabilities and challenging behaviours, but honestly, it's not essential.

No two days are the same, but here's what you might get up to!
- Helping the people we support get stuck into day-to-day activities and making the most of what's happening in the community and beyond.
- Supporting social activities and helping them keep in touch with family and mates.
- Lending a hand with managing finances.
- Keeping their home nice and tidy, plus doing the food shop.
- Providing and encouraging personal care.
- And most importantly, actually enjoying what you do!

What's in it for you?
- Early Pay - grab your wages quicker if you need to.
- We'll pay for your enhanced DBS.
- Flexible working.
- Paid annual leave (pro rata).
- Access to brilliant training that'll help you level up your career.
- Contributory pension scheme with life assurance.
- Shopping discounts via Blue Light Card and The Bene£its website.
- Recommend a mate scheme - bag yourself up to £500.
- Free and confidential 24/7 access to the health portal, counselling and support.

Sound good? Hit that apply button - we're buzzing to hear from you!

As part of our commitment to the "Disability Confident Scheme", candidates who declare a disability, and meet the key criteria for this role, will be given the opportunity to demonstrate their abilities at the interview stage.
